caption: The drawing is done in grayscale pencil on a cream-colored paper background and features a detailed rendering of a jug or tankard with a handle on the right side and a domed lid. The jug has ornate decorative patterns on its body, including vertical stripes, leaf motifs, and circular designs. Two slender sticks or rods protrude vertically from the top of the jug’s lid. There is a small, star-like ornament attached by a chain to the left side of the lid. The jug is centrally positioned within a thin, rectangular border that frames the composition, and the surrounding areas are left blank, focusing attention on the main object.
title: Lamp
